name: 45-Degree Back Extension
cues: Set the pad just below your hip crease so you can hinge freely
Hinge down with a long back until your hamstrings stretch
Squeeze your glutes to bring your body back in line with your legs
Stop at a straight line instead of arching past it
Hold a plate at your chest once bodyweight gets easy
